channel.title: panovi guides
channel.description: How to use panovi, the panoramic video app that turns two iPhones into one ultra-wide video: guides, tips for sports days, travel and soccer, and news.

item.title: How to lend your iPhone safely — keep it on panovi with Guided Access
item.description: The second iPhone for a panoramic video can be one you borrow from family or a friend. With Guided Access, built into every iPhone, the borrowed iPhone stays on the panovi screen — no photos, no messages, no notifications. Here is how to set it up, shoot, and clean up afterward, in about three minutes.

item.title: Getting started with panovi — shooting your first video
item.description: How to shoot an edge-to-edge panoramic video with two iPhones and a tripod. We walk through it in order — pair, place, shoot, stitch, and zoom in.

item.title: Placing your iPhones for a clean stitch — the tripod and the shallow V
item.description: How to build the mount that holds two iPhones on one tripod, and how to place them for a clean seam in your panoramic video. Plus how to use the setup check and the 3-second preview.

item.title: Film a whole soccer match — where to set up, the remote and the battery
item.description: How to film a match from start to finish as a panoramic video, with both goals in frame, without touching the tripod. Where to set up, a third iPhone as a remote, power save, free space, and pricing for long stitches.
